headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: history was made as Daniel Garcia vs. Wheeler Yuta contested the very first ROH Pure Title match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.98 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Garcia forced Yuta to tap in his own hometown of Buffalo to win the ROH Pure Championship, then stood arm in arm with Yuta's Blackpool Combat Club stablemates as a furious Chris Jericho looked on from the ramp.

2024 brought us this moment: Will Ospreay vs. PAC put the AEW International Title on the line, appearing on All Out, rated 9.25 ? a match fans still talk about. Ospreay survived Pac's full arsenal, hitting a Styles Clash into a second Hidden Blade to retain the International Championship in one of the night's standout matches.

Back on this day in 2022, there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Trios Titles as Death Triangle vs. Best Friends & Cassidy battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. For Death Triangle and Best Friends & Cassidy, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. With both the World and Trios titles vacated after the All Out fallout, Death Triangle beat Best Friends and a game Orange Cassidy to become new AEW World Trios Champions the very next Dynamite.

secondaries.text: It was 2022 when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Dax Harwood fought tooth and nail for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 8.15 ? one of the better matches of the year. It was the first title opportunity of Dax Harwood's career. Castagnoli survived a piledriver and a flurry of German suplexes from Harwood before locking in the Sharpshooter for the tap-out, extending his unbeaten run since joining AEW that June.

Looking back to 2024, when Adam Page vs. Swerve Strickland settled things in a Lights Out Steel Cage match, serving as the night's main event on All Out, rated 9.09 ? a match fans still talk about in a hard-fought men's division clash, on an outstanding All Out '24 show that earned an overall rating of 9.19. In a brutal Lights Out Steel Cage match that finally settled a year-long blood feud, Page choked out Strickland with the ring bell rope, leaving him laid out in the cage as the show closed.

Looking back to 2024, when Kazuchika Okada vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Mark Briscoe vs. Orange Cassidy put the AEW Continental Title on the line, appearing on All Out, rated 7.22 ? a match that delivered. It was the 10th time the AEW Continental Title had been on the line, a notable milestone for the title. In a four-way loaded with three former or future champions, Okada slipped past Takeshita and Briscoe to plant a Rainmaker on Cassidy and retain the Continental Championship.
